description: Churn risk dashboard showing churn probability distribution, high-risk users table, and risk filtering.

elements.label: Total Users KPI
elements.description: Shows the total number of users being monitored for churn.

elements.label: High Risk Users KPI
elements.description: Shows the number of high churn risk users.

elements.label: Medium Risk Users KPI
elements.description: Shows the number of medium churn risk users.

elements.label: Low Risk Users KPI
elements.description: Shows the number of low churn risk users.

elements.label: Churn Rate / Average Probability KPI
elements.description: Shows the overall average churn probability percentage.

elements.label: Churn Distribution Chart
elements.description: Donut chart showing the distribution of users by churn risk level (high, medium, low).

elements.label: Churn Risk Filter
elements.description: Dropdown filter for churn risk level (high, medium, low) on the churn page.
exampleUserQuestions: filter churn table to medium risk users

elements.label: Churn Users Table
elements.description: Table listing users with churn risk, final risk score, anomaly count, and last activity.

elements.label: Refresh Churn Data
exampleUserQuestions: show me the churn refresh button

elements.label: Previous Page Button
elements.description: Button to navigate to the previous page of churn users.

elements.label: Next Page Button
elements.description: Button to navigate to the next page of churn users.

elements.label: Live Connection Badge
elements.description: Badge showing the SSE live connection status for churn data.

elements.label: Data Source Chip
elements.description: Chip showing the data source for the churn data.
